title: apricity link subcommand: show the session's peers, tempo, playing state and phase
description:
## Intent
`apricity link`: look at the session without playing anything. Makes apricitus-627e11 green.

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-cli/src/main.rs`: `Cmd::Link { seconds: Option<f64> }` ("Show the Link session: peers, tempo, playing, bar and beat"); new `src/link.rs`.
2. Joins, prints the status line in place, stops after `--seconds` or Ctrl-C. It must never impose a tempo on a DAW that joins later: follow M0's finding on how Link merges a lone peer with a session (apricitus-5c021b); if a lone peer's tempo could win, it says "no other Link peers found" and does not linger alone.
3. The "no other peers" hint names the DAW's Link switch, the same network, and local network access for the terminal app (from M0's permission finding).

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-cli --test link_play` (apricitus-627e11 green).

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): apricity link`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
